text:
A metal conductor is connected to a battery.
Which statement describes the current in the metal conductor?
A
It is a flow of electrons from the negative to the positive terminal.
B
It is a flow of electrons from the positive to the negative terminal.
C
It is a flow of protons from the negative to the positive terminal.
D
It is a flow of protons from the positive to the negative terminal.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a flow of electrons from the negative to the positive terminal.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a flow of electrons from the positive to the negative terminal.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a flow of protons from the negative to the positive terminal.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a flow of protons from the positive to the negative terminal.
